critique: The render reads instantly as an open-frame FPGA NTT card: ISO shows all eight copper multiplier cylinders, the symmetric dark/brushed add-sub pairs, the blue BRAM stack on the -X edge, the exploded lane and finned heatsink lifted clear, and FRONT/SIDE confirm every part sits on the board with the buses standoff-grounded (no floaters). The single remaining actionable defect from the carried reflection was that the architecture's HEADLINE contribution — radix-4 — existed only in the config-selector spec text, not in geometry: eight radix-2 lanes with prose about fusion, and an exploded 'lane' whose roles even claimed a radix-4 butterfly it did not show. I closed that by enacting the fusion physically (four carbon-fiber radix-4 fusion yokes binding lane-pairs 0-1/2-3/4-5/6-7 into four 4-input BUs) and by rebuilding the exploded cluster into a true radix-4 butterfly (three twiddle multipliers W1/W2/W3, the constant j=psi^512 rotator as a torus, and the y0..y3 add/sub tree), so the X-ray view now teaches the paper's actual datapath. The only residual is inherent to any static scene — the concurrent 9-cycle pipeline cannot be enacted as timed structure — which is a property of the medium, not a fixable scene defect worth >2 points.
changelog: Enacted the radix-4 headline in geometry: added four carbon-fiber 'Radix-4 Fusion Yoke' members (lanes 0-1, 2-3, 4-5, 6-7) seated in the open gap between the multiplier and add/sub columns, each binding its lane-pair's two DSP multipliers into one fused 4-input radix-4 BU, with a spec recording the W1/W2/W3 twiddles, the j rotator and the 33% mult saving — turning the eight radix-2 lanes into the four radix-4 BUs the paper headlines

Rebuilt the exploded cluster from a generic radix-2 lane into a true radix-4 butterfly: replaced the single ex_mult with three twiddle multipliers ex_mult_w1/w2/w3 (b'=W1x1, c'=W2x2, d'=W3x3) plus a brass torus ex_jrot for the constant j=psi^512 rotator, and rewrote ex_add/ex_sub/ex_reg roles to the y0..y3 radix-4 add/sub tree and four-output register — the exploded view now matches its own captions and teaches the contribution
Widened the exploded baseplate (depth 1.6 -> 1.9) so the three multipliers fit without overhanging, and kept the +Z offset so it still clears central lanes 3-4 in plan view

Separated the read/twiddle/return routing triad in elevation: thinned the operand-read bus (depth 0.32 -> 0.26) and lifted it to y=1.5, raised the twiddle broadcast rail/feeder/standoff to y=1.72, leaving read (1.5) / return (1.62) / twiddle (1.72) on three distinct layers to de-crowd the lane-3/4 gap in TOP

Updated assembly_instructions steps 4 and 8 to install the four radix-4 fusion yokes and to describe the exploded view as a fused radix-4 BU; preserved metadata.info, metadata.spec, thumbnail_camera and every existing part spec unchanged
